## Projects

- [NeoViolet](https://github.com/AuroraStudio-aurorast/NeoViolet) — Terminal music player
- [Violet Player](https://github.com/AuroraStudio-aurorast/Violet3) — Lightweight Windows music player
- [CozyUI Ex](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex) — Unofficial CozyUI+ Minecraft resource pack extension
- [PerformTracker](https://github.com/WhatDamon/PerformTracker-Mod) — Minecraft performance monitoring mod
